body.message:
Hi, this is Rashid. I saw your 3 bedroom property in Ajman on Airbnb and wanted to ask about it.  

I’m with two friends, we’ve recently moved to Dubai and run an online business, so we’re looking for a place we can stay and work from for a longer period, around a month to start and possibly more.  

We’re currently in Dubai but open to relocating to Ajman if it makes sense. Just wanted to check if you might be able to offer a better rate for a longer stay.  

Let me know, thanks.
Rashid
